L8n908.name: Sea and shipping
L8n908.description: Fires on sea, port and ship words; pushes toward sea, ocean and shore words.

L19n834.name: Ships and marine water
L19n834.description: Negative pole fires on ship, dock and port words; writes marine and sailor words, but steering gives generic fiction.

L14n92.name: Scattered words to closers
L14n92.description: Fires on assorted content words and commas with no shared theme; pushes toward closing quote and bracket punctuation.

L14n2251.name: Weak diffuse noise
L14n2251.description: Barely fires on academic and technical nouns; writes scattered word fragments with no shared concept.

L23n2405.name: Than comparison predictor
L23n2405.description: Reads comparatives right before 'than' (more, rather, less, most); pushes toward 'than'.

L23n2299.name: Weak reads, vector writes
L23n2299.description: Weak, scattered reads on technical nouns and word fragments (acceleration, Jet, Feature); pushes toward 'vector'.

L22n2377.name: Consequence phrases, effect writes
L22n2377.description: Reads loosely on consequence and outcome phrases (cumulative effects, withdrawal, fluorescence energy); pushes toward 'effect' and 'effects'.

L24n2899.name: Connectives read, port writes
L24n2899.description: Reads connective function words mid-phrase (and, for, in, has); pushes toward 'port'.

L22n2178.name: Weak question reads, proof writes
L22n2178.description: Weak reads on problem-set punctuation and pronouns ('problem 3:', 'Is it a curve?'); pushes toward 'proof' and 'prove'.

L21n1228.name: Weak function-word reads, zero
L21n1228.description: Very weak reads on function words after verbs (because, with, of, to); pushes toward 'zero'.

L24n948.name: Intersex reads, opposite writes
L24n948.description: Reads 'inter-' in intersex and 'at/in the same' phrases; pushes toward 'opposite' and 'adjacent'.

L21n1442.name: Superlatives read, choice writes
L21n1442.description: Reads superlatives and best-pick words (top, best, leading, ideal, first); pushes toward 'choice' and 'choices'.
